fields.meaning: Current-state E can request quest collection, unopened shortcut activation, or return with quest and warmth conditions met in the occupied cell

rules: Enabled by environment.interaction_ready=true in RealtimeMansionEnv experiments
The occupied cell uses floor(continuous center + 0.5), matching RealtimeGameCore interactions
Terminal snapshots encode 0; nonterminal external truncation retains state-derived readiness
Exit branch takes priority over quest and shortcut branches, matching GameCore
Derived from current state; does not predict success after damage or time processing
Action availability, game transitions, reward, termination, physics clock and RNG are unchanged
Base grid 620 and extended grid 621 remain unchanged; realtime base is 630 and extended is 631
